title: [review] reconcile RX8130CE battery-switchover mode 2 semantics vs datasheet (driver comment contradicts binding)
description: P3, potential HW config footgun. lichen/dts/bindings/rtc/lichen,rx8130ce-rtc.yaml:36 says mode 2 = NON-rechargeable (matches upstream binding), while lichen/drivers/rtc/rtc_rx8130ce.c:236 comment (copied from upstream driver, upstream:712) says mode 2 = rechargeable. Register writes identical to upstream; the two upstream docs disagree. Resolve against the RX8130CE datasheet (section on VLOW/backup switchover, INIEN/CHGEN bits) and fix the losing description. Non-rechargeable cell + charging enabled can damage hardware, so getting the doc right matters. Cross-check the other 3 modes while in there.
